ObjectName.value: Calcite-121368

Categories.value: Self-published work|Items with VRTS permission confirmed|Images by Rob Lavinsky|La Arana Quarry|Orange calcite

ImageDescription.value:
Calcite
Locality: La Araña Quarry, La Cala, Málaga, Andalusia, Spain (Locality at mindat.org)
Size: 5.6 x 4.8 x 3.9 cm.
These are really attractive and unique Calcites from a lesser known region in Spain. This rich golden color crystal group consists of scalenohedra with cactus-like "arms" growing from the sides of the prisms of the larger crystals. The crystals have a silky luster and are rather gemmy when backlit.
